contexts.text: Man never produces from himself anything false and evil; but the evil Spirits with him produce them.
Production is continual creation.
It is the influx through Heaven which produces all things in the three kingdoms...
Corresponds to the affection of... producing truths.
To gestate in the womb = to produce something.

To be produced, when predicated of the Church, is the good which is produced through truth; and it is produced when truth passes through the understanding into the will, and from the will into act... When it is in the will, it is in its womb, and is then first produced; and, when the man is in good in act; that is, when he produces good from the will... it is born.
That nothing of good could be produced (is here sig.).
Truths and goods... cannot be produced the one without the other.
Nothing is ever produced, unless good and truth become a one by... marriage.
Heat and light must act as a one for anything to be produced...
When good is in the first place... it produces truths continually...
That (all things) may be continually producing something.
The sons of Israel were fruitful and were productive ()... To be productive = further derivation. Explained.
The things which have no relation to both (good and truth) together, do not produce anything. Good is that which produces, and truth is that through which [anything is produced].
For anything to be produced, there must be two forces, one active and the other passive...
Good itself, which is the Divine Esse, produces all things through its truth.
From the truth of good, good was produced again... Signified. There are such productions and derivations of truth with those of the Spiritual Church. Representation.
Then good... produces a new man...
For good prolificates and produces itself through truths...
(In this way) the one is produced and derived from the other; and the first is the all in the products and derivatives...
These degrees are... distinct, like the thing producing, and the thing produced. HH 38:2.
See Proceed.
That the Internal produces the External. References.
It produces the affection of truth... (Thus) love produces faith... and, through this, it produces charity. DFaith 14.
Affection produces nothing from itself except through thought...
Faith does not produce good from itself but from charity...
Charity produces faith; and not faith charity.
Force is produced by endeavour... and motion is produced through force...
That in earths there is an endeavour to produce uses in forms. Explained.
The first production from these earths... was the production of seeds.
The influx thence produces such things immediately...
Nature contributes nothing whatever to the productions of plants and animals. Shown.
That nature has produced nothing, and produces nothing; but the Divine... General article.
(Shown) in the productions of plants.
(Shown) in the productions of animals. CL 416. TCR 12.
But the finite can be produced by the infinite.
That the Lord produces goods with man according to every state of truth with him. Signified, Explained.
The soul of man, being in the marriage of good and truth, ... is in the perpetual effort for the fructification and production of its own likeness...
Faith alone cannot possible produce or bring forth any works which are called fruits.
That the Divine Esse and Existere in itself cannot produce another Divine... Explained.
To produce the things which the love wills and the understanding thinks.
How can posteriors produce priors...
It is his honour to produce these things.
What good temptations produce.
How dreams are produced. Explained.
In the other life thoughts are brought forth. (Explained.)
The idea brings it forth. SE 3606.
One phantasy produces another.
They would bring forth from the memory nothing but his evils and falsities.
To extend the earth and its products () = to form the Church and reform those there; products = all things of the Church.
The products of the months () = all things which proceed from the Spiritual Kingdom. AE 448:7.
That which proceeds, produces.
They are the derivations and productions of (these) uses.
Works are their productions and effects.
The production of falsity from evil by Hell. Signified.
The productions in a series. Signified.
In both cases the production is effected in the time of spring.
Whence is the production and generation of all things.
The thing producing is love; the thing produced thence is of love from good through truth. The ultimate products, in our world, are various... All the things produced are correspondences.
Everyone has delight from... production as from himself.
Spiritual germinations are productions of wisdom from love; and then in every production there is a soul from that love, and its clothing from the wisdom.
The root is in the interiors, and the production in the exteriors...

The first is the Sun...; the intermediates are spiritual things; then natural ones; then terrestrial ones; from which, ultimately, are productions... So that productions are continual... Therefore the productions, which are chiefly animals and plants, are continuations of creation. (Although) the continuations are effected by means of seeds, still it is the same creating force which produces. (And) some seeds are still being produced.
The force of forming... is the force of producing animals and plants from the ultimate matters of nature...

Discrete degrees... are as the producing force to the produced forces, again become producing down to the ultimate product... All creation is effected through these degrees; and all production is through them...
That love produces heat. Explained.
2. The first forms (in embryos) do not appear to the eye; but their first productions, which make the head.
3. From these forms... are brought forth and produced all things of the body. Explained.
4. That these productions are effected according to the laws of correspondence. Explained.
For all things of man, from head to heel, are productions.
2. Affection produces thought; and thought reproduces affection. Explained.
